definitions.curve: Monthly TX contract settlement-price vector ordered by expiry on the same regular-session date.
definitions.annualizedRollYield: (nearPrice-farPrice)/nearPrice * 365/(farDTE-nearDTE). Descriptive carry/roll proxy only; not realized return.
definitions.basis: front monthly TX settlement price - same-date TAIEX cash close.
definitions.oi: contract-level end-of-day open interest, preserved separately from price curve.

versusBasis: 2026-09-14 and 2026-09-16 have nearly identical negative front basis (-18.65 vs -19.61 bps), but front-next spread changes from -126 to -301 points.
2026-09-15 basis flips positive (+17.69 bps) while front-next spread remains contango at -135 points.
versusOi: Open-interest migration identifies which contract becomes dominant but does not determine the price slope across expiries.
After the September expiry, front OI share stays near 98% on 2026-09-17, 2026-09-18 and 2026-10-02 while front-next spreads still vary -157, -153 and -171 points.
residualEvidence.conclusion: Futures curve shape contains a distinct contract-price dimension that is neither spot-futures basis nor open-interest concentration.

continuousContract.decisionRule: At close t, any roll decision applies only from the next trading session. Roll from current selected contract to next monthly contract when front calendar DTE<=5 OR next-contract OI exceeds front OI.
continuousContract.priceHistoryRule: Never retroactively back-adjust historical raw contract prices for feature replay.
continuousContract.chartRule: If a stitched chart is needed, create a separate return/index object with explicit roll event and gap; do not overwrite source prices.
continuousContract.rollDayReturnRule: Without an explicit executable roll-price convention, cross-contract return over the switch is UNKNOWN rather than calculated from two different contract closes.
continuousContract.observedTransition: On 2026-09-14 both DTE<=5 and next OI>front OI trigger a next-session roll; therefore a PIT-safe synthetic contract would select 202610 from 2026-09-15 onward rather than waiting for 202609 expiry.

contaminationGuards: monthly TX only; weekly/flexible contracts excluded
settlement price must be positive; otherwise use positive close only as an explicitly flagged fallback; neither valid => UNKNOWN
expiry-day front contract is a special state and not a normal curve observation
price limit/session identity must be preserved
OI and volume are quality/position dimensions, not substitutes for curve slope
cash basis and inter-contract curve are separate primitives

overlapBoundary.D12_01: owns cash-index versus one futures-contract basis
overlapBoundary.D12_07: owns option IV skew/term structure, not futures-price term structure
overlapBoundary.COV07: owns multi-expiry futures price curve, calendar spreads, roll-yield/carry and continuous-contract roll semantics

rationale: Official Taiwan contract-level historical prices/OI/volume and expiry semantics are replay-feasible, and real same-parent states demonstrate residual curve information distinct from D12-01 basis and D12-02 OI.
